lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
Say married to before a person.
To! He is married to my sister.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.
data.why: Say married to before a person.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «متزوجة بطبيب»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول married to: “She is married to a doctor.” وليس “She is married with a doctor.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “She is married with a doctor” 😅 مع married نستخدم to قبل الشخص، فالجملة الصحيحة “She is married to a doctor.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “to” — مع married نستخدم to قبل الشخص. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: Before a person we say married to: “She is married to a doctor.” not “She is married with a doctor.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “She is married with a doctor” 😅 Before a person we say married to, so the right sentence is “She is married to a doctor.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
